text:
Aisha: Kicking off the infra/capacity follow-up from today's All-hands. Thread for Qs on GPUs, regions, autoscaling. I'll answer with Marco where needed.
Marco: Quick summary — procurement softened our Q3 lead times, new eu-central capacity expected in Sep, APAC pilot in Q4. Autoscale improvements are rolling in next sprint.
Devon: Can you clarify if Dedicated customers get priority for new GPU batches?
Marco: Yes — Dedicated (reserved) customers are bumped to the front of the allocation queue for that customer's committed region/pool. Public hosted runs on remaining capacity and burst infra.
Priya: How will we surface capacity shortages to teams? We need better visibility than the current ticket flow.
Marco: Working with Devex to add a capacity flag in Console and an /infra-status Slack integration. Plan: per-region utilization dashboard + predictive alerts (72h runway warnings).
Tam: Any specifics on the GPUs arriving? type/model + vendor? Customers ask about FP16 perf.
Marco: Primary shipments are 80% H100-class, 20% A100-80GB for early Q3. We're also testing L40x for mixed precision workloads.
Sasha: For model owners: will we auto-fallback to quantized variants when H100 isn't available?
Marco: Yes — routing policy will prefer the pinned model, but if capacity is constrained we can fall back to a compatible quantized variant in the same family. This is configurable per route.
Jenna: Do we have a recommended autoscale config for inference-heavy chat endpoints?
Priya: Quick recommend: min_replicas=2, target_utilization=0.6, max_replicas based on p95 token throughput. We'll publish a cookbook.
Theo: Any change to burst credit policy for Hosted during high-traffic events?
Aisha: We're expanding burst capacity pool by 30% for paid tiers and adding a transparent burst cost metric in billing.
Devon: How about multi-region failover? Is cross-region replication for KV caches in scope?
Marco: Cross-region KV replication is planned for Q4; short-term we'll rely on route-level fallbacks + cache warming. We'll document expected cold-start latencies.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC — small infra config updates, no expected downtime :white_check_mark:
Tam: What are the SLA/latency expectations once autoscale improvements land?
Marco: Targeting 99.9% availability for Dedicated with p95 < 250ms on common short-seq generation. Hosted target p95 ~ 350-450ms depending on model size.
Nora: Any estimated impact on unit economics (per-token cost) with extra H100s?
Marco: Early estimates show ~8-12% cost reduction on medium-length workloads due to better kernel utilization and batching. We'll refine with real telemetry.
Sasha: Would love a migration guide for teams to opt-into smart routing and fallback policies.
Aisha: Good call — Priya + Jenna to own a short migration playbook and sample configs. Jenna can help with customer-facing notes.
Jenna: I'll draft cookbook + a Terraform snippet for Dedicated pools next week.
Devon: Can we get a quick CLI example of the new autoscale config schema?
Marco: Sure — example we discussed in the RFC:

```
redwood infra autoscale set \ 
  --route chat/short-seq \ 
  --min 2 --max 20 --target-util 0.6 \ 
  --fallback-model gpt-small-quant \ 
  --region eu-central
```

Priya: Note: the autoscaler will respect customer min_replicas even during constrained capacity if they have reserved seats.
Tam: For customers in APAC, will region rollout include localized support hours?
Aisha: Yes — we'll spin up a small regional support rota for the APAC pilot.
Sasha: How are we measuring success for the autoscale rollout? KPIs?
Marco: KPIs: reduction in tail latency during spikes, fewer manual scale ops, % requests served without fallback, and cost per 1M tokens.
Devon: Follow-up — will rollout require client-side changes?
Marco: Mostly config only. App changes needed only if you want to opt into new routing behaviors. We'll provide defaults that are safe.
Aisha: Thanks everyone — keep questions here. We'll pin the infra roadmap doc and the autoscale RFC: https://redwood.internal/docs/infra-autoscale (internal). :rocket:
Priya: Adding my +1 for a prewarm API to avoid cold-starts on large models.
Marco: Prewarm API is on the roadmap for Q4, prioritized for Dedicated customers first.
Tam: Anything customers should expect to change in SLA language?
Nora: We'll update SLRs for Dedicated within the contract addendum — no changes to free tier SLAs.
Devon: Great thread, I have a few 1:1s to schedule for migration planning.
Aisha: Awesome — team will follow up. :party:
